references.text: David's prayer that God's enemies may perish, just as Deborah's song wishes that the Lord's enemies will come to ruin
A psalm asking that Israel's enemies be destroyed, with the same theme of the downfall of God's enemies
Concerns those who love the Lord and hate evil, parallel to the distinction between the Lord's enemies and those who love him
The righteous will shine like the sun in their Father's kingdom, the same image as that those who love the Lord are like the sun when it rises in its strength
The land had rest for forty years under Othniel, the same period of peace as after Deborah's victory
The land had rest for forty years under Gideon, parallel to the period of peace mentioned here
Moses' prayer that the Lord's enemies may scatter and flee, the same theme of the enemy's downfall
Jesus is described with a face like the sun when it shines in its strength, the same solar image as in Judges
Those who love wisdom are loved in return, parallel to the blessing for those who love the Lord
